description: Testbenches shipped: the controller bench, the program-select width sweep and the sense-margin bench, with one cold-start command (sim/cold-start.sh) and the pinned PDK and tool versions. The cold start runs the controller bench and validates each analog bench's klt sim request set with --dry-run; the full corner campaigns are batch submissions (sim/README.md, Testbench inventory), so this attestation shows the benches exist, are pinned and launch, not that any margin or current passes.
